synopsis.text:
WCW: World Championship Wrestling is an isometric  wrestling game of the National Wrestling Alliance. 
Players can choose to engage in one- or two-player matches as either 1vs1 solo bouts or 2vs2 tag-teams. Upon selecting a mode, players choose their characters from among twelve featured wrestlers from the NWA league. Licensed characters include: Rick Flair ("Nature Boy"), Sting, Lex Luger ("Total Package"), Mike Rotunda, Road Warrior Hawk, Road Warrior Animal, Steve Williams (""Dr. Death"), Kevin Sullivan ("Gamemaster"), Ricky Steamboat ("The Dragon"), Ric Steiner ("Dogface Gremlin"), Eddie Gilbert ("Hotstuff") and Michael P.S. Hayes. Each wrestler has unique abilities not shared by the other wrestlers, including finishing moves and rope toss.

Prior to a match, the player is presented with a menu of eight "moves", of which the player chooses four to assign to the points of the directional pad. Once the match starts, the player is only able to use the four moves selected and the rope toss to attack the opponent. Each wrestler can move up, down, left and right inside the wrestling ring, climb the turnstiles at each corner and throw opponents out of the ring (where they will be disqualified if outside for 20 seconds). Each wrestler has a high damage "finisher move" which can only be performed when they are standing in the middle of the ring and the opponent's stamina bar is low.

WCW : World Championship Wrestling est un jeu de catch en 2D isométrique sur Nes. Possédant les licences de la National Wrestling Alliance, le jeu propose des matchs en un contre un ou en deux contre deux, avec des légendes du catch telles que Nature Boy, Total Package ou The Dragon.

WCW: World Championship Wrestling ist ein isometrisches Wrestling-Spiel der National Wrestling Alliance. Die Spieler können wählen, ob sie Kämpfe mit einem oder zwei Spielern als 1vs1-Solokämpfe oder 2vs2-Tag-Teams bestreiten wollen. Nach der Auswahl eines Modus wählen die Spieler ihre Charaktere aus zwölf Wrestlern der NWA-Liga aus. Zu den lizenzierten Charakteren gehören Rick Flair ("Nature Boy"), Sting, Lex Luger ("Total Package"), Mike Rotunda, Road Warrior Hawk, Road Warrior Animal, Steve Williams (""Dr. Death"), Kevin Sullivan ("Gamemaster"), Ricky Steamboat ("The Dragon"), Ric Steiner ("Dogface Gremlin"), Eddie Gilbert ("Hotstuff") und Michael P.S. Hayes. Jeder Wrestler hat einzigartige Fähigkeiten, die die anderen Wrestler nicht haben, darunter Finishing Moves und Seilwürfe.

WCW: World Championship Wrestling es un juego de lucha isométrica de la National Wrestling Alliance. Los jugadores pueden optar por participar en partidas de uno o dos jugadores, ya sea en combates individuales 1vs1 o en equipos de 2vs2. Al seleccionar un modo, los jugadores eligen a sus personajes de entre doce luchadores destacados de la liga NWA. Los personajes con licencia incluyen: Rick Flair ("Nature Boy"), Sting, Lex Luger ("Total Package"), Mike Rotunda, Road Warrior Hawk, Road Warrior Animal, Steve Williams ("" Dr. Death "), Kevin Sullivan (" Gamemaster ", Ricky Steamboat (" The Dragon "), Ric Steiner (" Dogface Gremlin "), Eddie Gilbert (" Hotstuff ") y Michael PS Hayes. Cada luchador tiene habilidades únicas que no comparten los otros luchadores, incluidos movimientos finales y técnicas de cuerda.

WCW: World Championship Wrestling è un gioco di wrestling isometrico della National Wrestling Alliance. I giocatori possono scegliere di partecipare a partite di uno o due giocatori, sia in singolo combattimento 1vs1 che in squadre 2vs2. Quando si seleziona una modalità, i giocatori scelgono i loro personaggi tra dodici importanti lottatori della lega NWA. I personaggi con licenza includono: Rick Flair ("Nature Boy"), Sting, Lex Luger ("Pacchetto totale"), Mike Rotunda, Road Warrior Hawk, Road Warrior Animal, Steve Williams ("Dr. Death"), Kevin Sullivan (" Gamemaster", Ricky Steamboat ("The Dragon"), Ric Steiner ("Dogface Gremlin"), Eddie Gilbert ("Hotstuff") e Michael PS Hayes. Ogni combattente ha abilità uniche non condivise dagli altri combattenti, comprese le mosse finali e tecniche di corda.

WCW: World Championship Wrestling é um jogo de luta isométrica da National Wrestling Alliance.
Os jogadores podem optar por participar de partidas de um ou dois jogadores como lutas individuais a 1vs1 ou equipes de tag 2vs2. Ao selecionar um modo, os jogadores escolhem seus personagens dentre os doze lutadores da liga da NWA. Os personagens licenciados incluem: Rick Flair ("Nature Boy"), Sting, Lex Luger ("Pacote Total"), Mike Rotunda, Road Warrior Hawk, Road Warrior Animal, Steve Williams ("Dr. Morte"), Kevin Sullivan (" Gamemaster "), Ricky Steamboat (" O Dragão "), Ric Steiner (" Dogface Gremlin "), Eddie Gilbert (" Hotstuff ") e Michael PS Hayes. Cada lutador tem habilidades únicas não compartilhadas pelos outros, incluindo movimentos de finalização e arremesso de corda.
